featured_reviews.name: dazy jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my disappointment with a recent purchase of your magical painting book for my Son.
We have previously used your product and books and had a great experience
Which is why we have bought the product again from your brand.
However the experience this time has been very disappointing and unsatisfied and it's seems like you hav given us the dead stock in exhibition which was held in @weavers preschool.
The pen provided with the book was not working or functioning
Have reached out to the team for refund or give me someother product once the defective piece of book  was returned.and the staff being very rude.
Now the defective book which was asked to return to you back which was done already on the next day.
However your team members are not reachable or not giving refund.
I guys are fraud.. you kept the book and in exchange you have not given any other book nor I got the money return.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ms. Jaiswal,

We’re truly sorry that this experience has been upsetting for you and your child. As parents ourselves, we completely understand how disappointing it can feel when something doesn’t meet expectations, especially when it’s meant to bring joy.

We sincerely appreciate the trust you’ve placed in BookyWooky in the past, and we value that relationship deeply. Our team has stayed connected with you across Instagram and WhatsApp throughout, doing our best to understand your concern and work towards a fair resolution. Please be assured that we remain available and committed to resolving this in the best possible way.

Just to share some clarity for everyone reading:

1. The Magical Water Colouring book is designed to reveal colors when wet and gently fade as it dries, making it reusable. In the video shared with us by Ms. Jaiswal, the book and pen were functioning as intended. This feature, including the fading of colors, is part of the product design and is also mentioned on the product.

2. As you insisted on a refund, we requested the book back so we could personally check it and offer a replacement if there was any issue with the piece.

3. Upon receiving the book, we observed that it had visible damage, including torn areas and marks from non-water coloring. Due to this, the book is no longer in a condition where we can process a refund or replacement. For complete transparency, we have also shared photos and videos here:
https://photos.app.goo.gl/AaWuENy16rpuYRS89

We completely understand that this outcome may not have been what you were hoping for and we truly regret the disappointment caused.

That said, we are still trying to make this as convenient as possible for you, the book is being dropped back at the preschool and you may collect it at your convenience. We would also be more than happy to continue assisting you in finding an alternative that your child will enjoy.

As a small brand built around parents and children, every experience matters deeply to us. As a gesture of goodwill, we had also shared a special offer for your next purchase, as we would genuinely value the opportunity to serve you better again.

We’re here, listening, and always willing to help.

Warm regards,
Team BookyWooky
8779689014

P.S. As a small gesture of goodwill to anyone reading this, we’d love for you to experience BookyWooky firsthand, please feel free to use a 10% discount (Code: REVIEW10) on your next order and discover the joy our books bring to little ones.

I was very hesitant in buying books from the website as it was new to me. But the response I got from the owner herself was very good. She kept me updated on the tracking details and I received the books within a week only.

Would highly highly recommend the website to everyone. They have books which I could not find anywhere else. The quality of the books and packaging is very very good.

Thank you Booky Wooky!! :-)
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you very much Riya! Your kind words motivate us to do even better 😁🙏

featured_reviews.name: Akshatha Nidharak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst experience with this site. I was sold a very old copy of the Lion King wind up book. Firstly it was being sold at an extrapolated price. But since my son loves the character, I didn't mind paying extra.

First of all,  I didn't hear from them for more than a week. Then on following up, I was told fresh stock is arriving in a day so I am being sent a new piece.

On receipt of the book, I see a very faded and heavily creased book. On opening out the map that has the track for the wind up toy to go on, the book just starts tearing. It was just disheartening!

On contacting them, I had the most atrocious response - saying it was torn on purpose or torn by my child and I wasn't aware of it.

I was asked to send back the book. I didnt receive a replacement and had to make peace with a 25% refund as that was "the best they could do". And oh there was admission that it was old stock!!!

I would like to report this site for fooling customers with bad stock and having the audacity to say we as customers are tearing books or worst still have our children tearing their old stock.

I will be moving to consumer court but I wanted to put in my Google review as well to avoid being duped by fraudulent and outright rude websites like these.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Akshatha, I'm so sorry you weren't happy with your experience. I had a detailed discussion over chat and call with you, and you agreed to the resolution we provided. If you weren't happy, we could have discussed it further. You agreed that the book may have got torn after delivery, I yet offered you a partial refund on it. 
I apologise you felt this way, we strive to thrill all our customers and their little ones, please let me know if there's anything more I can do for you. 
Best Regards,
Mahima
For Bookywooky.in

featured_reviews.name: Kichu
featured_reviews.review_text:
There is one thing I love and I thing I hate about this place.
What I love is how they have a collection of rare books
(some as old as 50-60 years) that is preserved in Mint condition.
I found a book from Osho that have been published in 1976 (back at a time he was known as Rajneesh.  I found this to be the GEM. These guys were unaware of the value of such a rare book, so I bought it at a reasonable price.

However, what I hate is the fact that they often put labels that are higher than the price that the book was originally selling for. Some of the users have also mentioned this here and I don't think it far from the truth.

Overall, I loved the collection of this place, so I am giving 3 stars
